arts.ttl: Jayden Addai scores 2 goals as Como beats Torino 5-1 to move into Serie A top 6
arts.sum: Jayden Addai scored a goal in each half as Como beat Torino 5-1 on Monday to move into the top six of Serie A and extend its unbeaten run to 11 matches in all competitions. Como’s first victory at Torino since April 1986 lifted the team into sixth place, one point above Juventus.
